<jats:title>Abstract</jats:title>
               <jats:p>The problem of defenition of the post-Newtonian parameter γ in massive scalar-tensor theories is considered. We demonstrate an equivalent correspondence between the post-Newtonian parameter γ and the parameter appearing in the equation of a null geodesic in massive scalar-tensor theories. We show that massive scalar-tensor theories can be distinguished from general relativity via the Shapiro time delay. All calculations are performed for hybrid metric-Palatini f(R)-gravity for the sake of illustration. The expression for Shapiro time delay  in hybrid f(R)-gravity is obtained for the first time.</jats:p>
title: On Shapiro time delay in massive scalar-tensor theories
